methods.name: DroidBot-GPT
methods.description: a two-step solution where the LLM model chooses to edit in a text box, DroidBot-GPT sends another prompt ended with “What should I enter to the view with the text ‘<text content>’? Just return the text and nothing else. ” , after which DroidBot-GPT types in the response.

methods.name: GUI description
methods.description: converting the GUI interface into a familiar natural language sentence that can be more readily processed by GPT models
